requirements.title: Function references and defined operations invoke functions during expression evaluation
requirements.definition: A function is invoked during expression evaluation by a function-reference or defined operation; actual argument expressions are evaluated, arguments are associated, and the function executes.

pending.function-reference-invokes-function: Call an integer function f() in an expression assigning a result variable initialized to -3; f returns 19 and the final value must be 20 for f()+1.
pending.defined-operation-invokes-function: Define a unary operator .tag. returning x+40 for input 2 and verify the expression .tag. 2 yields 42, not a default sentinel.
pending.function-actuals-evaluated-before-associ: Use an actual argument expression bump() that increments a module counter from -5 to 7 before the function body records the received value; verify the body sees 7 and the final result encodes 7.
pending.function-arguments-associated-before-exe: Pass a variable initialized to 11 through an explicit interface function that returns its dummy plus 5; verify 16.
pending.function-body-executes: Function body sets a module marker from -9 to 33 before returning 44; caller verifies both marker and result.

requirements.title: Function result value and characteristics are available from the interface
requirements.definition: After function execution completes, the function result value is available for the expression that invoked it, and the result characteristics are determined by the function interface.

pending.function-result-available-to-expression: Use f() returning 12 inside 2*f()+1 and verify exact integer 25 with the destination initialized to -99.
pending.function-result-characteristics-from-int: Declare an explicit interface for a rank-one default-character function with LEN 3, SIZE 2, and result values ["abc","def"]; assign it to a rank-one length-3 destination initialized to ["###","@@@"] and verify LEN is 3, KIND equals KIND("a"), SIZE is 2, and exact values are ["abc","def"].

requirements.title: Elemental function array arguments have the same shape in elemental references
requirements.definition: For an elemental reference to an elemental function, all array arguments shall have the same shape.

pending.elemental-function-array-arguments-same-: Positive source control calls an elemental function add1 on arrays of identical shape [2,2] initialized with [1,2,3,4] and verifies [2,3,4,5]. A mutation changes only one actual shape and remains a program-restriction contrast with no diagnostic facet.
